title: Kabutops Folds Its Blades to Swim Faster

direction.premise: Kabutops turns its razor-sharp sickles and limbs into a swimming advantage by folding them inward.
direction.audiencePromise: See how Kabutops's weapons become the key to its fast swimming.
direction.openLoop: How can folding sharp weapons make Kabutops swim faster?
direction.payoff: By becoming more compact, Kabutops can wiggle its shell and swim fast.
direction.engagementQuestion: Fold for speed, or keep your weapons ready?

voice.instructions: Sound like a knowledgeable fan sharing a surprising fact. Use quick, warm pacing. Stress sharpest, folding, and fast. Pause briefly before the final choice.

scenes.headline: SHARPEST BLADES. FASTEST SWIM.
scenes.narration: Kabutops's sharpest weapons become its swimming advantage.
scenes.caption: ITS BLADES MAKE IT FASTER

scenes.headline: LIMBS TUCK IN
scenes.narration: Its Pokédex says Kabutops tucks in its limbs underwater.
scenes.caption: LIMBS FOLD INWARD

scenes.headline: THE BLADES FOLD TOO
scenes.narration: Then it folds its razor-sharp sickles, shrinking into a compact shape.
scenes.caption: SHARP BLADES. SMALLER SILHOUETTE.

scenes.headline: IT WIGGLES ITS SHELL
scenes.narration: That compact shape helps it wiggle its shell and swim fast.
scenes.caption: WIGGLE. SWIM. FAST.

scenes.headline: FOLDING SICKLES. FAST SWIMMING.
scenes.narration: Its blades aren't just weapons. Folding them helps it move fast.
scenes.caption: FOLDING TURNS BLADES INTO SPEED

scenes.headline: SPEED OR READY BLADES?
scenes.narration: Fold for speed, or keep your weapons ready?
scenes.caption: FOLD FOR SPEED OR STAY READY?
